facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/da.sample_batch_from_dataset: sample a batch of pixel data from the LocalRFDataset with specified batch size and number of views
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/da.activate_frames_incrementally: activate additional frames in the LocalRFDataset to expand the active frame window for training
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/da.deactivate_old_frames: deactivate old frames from the LocalRFDataset to free memory and shift the active window forward
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/da.concatenate_and_append_arrays: concatenate and append numpy arrays along a specified dimension using the concatenate_append utility function
